title: Buaflow assumption ledger v1
description: Every guess a project is building on, with who owns it, what breaks if it is wrong, until when it may stand unverified, and how it will be checked (IC-004). The kit already forbids guessing where a person can be asked ([NEEDS CLARIFICATION]); this is for the guesses that have to be made anyway to keep moving, so that each one either gets checked or visibly expires.

statement.description: The guess, stated so that it can turn out false.

madeIn.description: Repository-relative file where the guess is relied on (intent, spec, ADR). Checked for existence.

owner.description: A person who can confirm or refute it — not a team, not 'AI'.

impact.description: What breaks if it is wrong: high = architecture, security, money or data; medium = a feature's shape; low = wording or defaults.

expiresOn.description: The last day this guess may stand unverified. After it, an open assumption fails the gate.

method.description: How it will be checked: who is asked, what is measured, which test would fail.

consequence.description: Required when refuted: what was changed because the guess was wrong.
